messages:
jordan h: heads-up - apiserver P95 jumped to ~1.2s in eu-west1 at 00:10 UTC, controller-manager reconcile queue climbing, lease renewals failing intermittently. I see a big pile of Attach/Detach events tied to the new GPU onboarding batch.

sre-bot: alert: apiserver_5xx_rate increased by 4.8x over 5m in eu-west1 - sample: 00:10:12 -> 00:15:00 UTC. related metrics: apiserver_request_latencies_seconds_bucket, controller_manager_queue_length.

maria g: we kicked a dedicated-gpu onboarding job at 00:05 UTC (batch of 120 nodes). rolling create via infra-provisioner.

liam: can someone check conntrack / nat ephemeral ports? last time onboarding this many GPUs we saturated NAT and saw keepalives fail -> controller queues. grabbing conntrack snapshot.

liam: ```
# conntrack -S
entries 174900
searches 1243456
found 171234
expected_max_per_nat 65535
# iptables -t nat -L POSTROUTING -n | grep SNAT
SNAT  all  --  10.0.0.0/8         0.0.0.0/0            to:34.56.78.90
```

nina: graph: https://prom.redwood.internal/graph?g=apiserver+p95+eu-west1 (watch the sharp spike 00:09->00:12). also et cetera: etcd leader handoff around 00:11 per log.

jordan h: good catch. etcd leader flip at 00:11 might explain transient 5xxs, but the reconcilers stayed blocked. suspect two contributing factors: conntrack/NAT exhaustion + a short WAL I/O surge during compaction.

maria g: infra-provisioner logs show parallel attach operations spiking IO to PV backends at 00:08-00:10. created 4x baseline attach rate.

liam: quick mitigation: cordon the onboarding batch nodes and stop further attach attempts. Can infra rollback the job?

maria g: pausing now. rolling back to safe window - paused at 00:18 UTC.

jordan h: also lowering controller-manager --concurrent-reconciles from 20 -> 8 for the eu-west1 controller-manager deployment to reduce apiserver QPS. patch applied: ```kubectl -n kube-system patch deploy controller-manager-eu-west1 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"controller-manager","command":["/controller","--concurrent-reconciles=8"]}]}}}}'```

liam: after cordon + reduce reconciles, connections stabilized, conntrack entries dropped ~60k over 5m. etctd leader settled. I see apiserver P95 back to ~180ms by 00:30.

nina: noting follow-up: we need a long-term fix - nat pool sizing and ephemeral port reclaim tuning for heavy attach bursts. filing ticket.

maria g: flagged infra-provisioner to add a steady-rate limiter on attach operations in the next release. ticket created: INF-2892.

jordan h: action items: 1) resize NAT pool or move onboarding to region with larger nat capacity, 2) add attach-rate limiter, 3) review etcd compaction schedule relative to onboarding windows, 4) add runbook step to reduce controller-manager concurrency for bursts.

liam: +1, also propose adding a short-lived route fallback to eu-central1 if eu-west1 apiserver latency > 500ms for >2m.

nina: I'll own the follow-up doc and runbook update.

sre-bot: incident-note: mitigated at 00:30 UTC by pausing onboarding + controller-manager concurrency change. severity: low->warning.

jordan h: thanks team. closing this thread, follow-up in INF-2892 and runbook PR once drafted. :white_check_mark:
